intent: A custom single-value select that behaves like the native control: typeahead, Home and End, grouped options, a gliding spring highlight and a check that draws on the chosen row. The panel unfolds from its trigger and flips upward near the bottom edge. Monochrome, with one accent on the check.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants, layoutId, pathLength, AnimatePresence popLayout, useReducedMotion), lucide-react for the chevron and search icon

layout.root: @container column, max-width 320px, trigger full width; hints hide below a 224px container (@max-[14rem])
layout.label: mono 11px uppercase label, 8px above the trigger
layout.trigger: md 44px / sm 36px, radius 10px, inset hairline, value left, hint, 16px chevron right
layout.panel: trigger width, 6px gap above or below, radius 12px, list max 320px (fold lands mid-row), rows 44px (md, matching the trigger) or 32px (sm, 44px on coarse pointers), radius 8px, bottom 32px fades out while rows lie below the fold
layout.search: optional 44px filter row at the top of the panel; input 16px always (iOS zoom)

typography.row: 14px or 13px, body colour, selected in ink
typography.hint: mono 11.5px (11px on sm), tabular-nums, hint colour
typography.label: mono 11px uppercase, tracking 0.12em

color.tokens: PALETTE dark and light to --sl-* variables (accent included); the accent is used only on the check. Default accent #7dd3a8 on dark, #1f9d6b on light (mint is about 1.7:1 on white)
color.dark: field #141416, panel #111113, ink #f4f4f5, body #c4c4ca, hint #8a8a93, hairline 8% white
color.light: field #ffffff, panel #ffffff, ink #18181b, body #3f3f46, hint #6b6b74, hairline 10% ink, accent #1f9d6b

motion.reveal: block rises 8px out of 6px blur, 500ms ease-out, 50ms delay, once on mount
motion.panel: unfolds from the trigger edge: scaleY 0.9 to 1, 6px drift, 4px blur, 260ms ease-out; exit 140ms ease-in
motion.highlight: one layoutId element on spring.ui (500/40), glides between rows; its id is new per opening so it starts in place
motion.check: pathLength 0 to 1 over 320ms, 40ms delay, remounts with selection
motion.press: row content scale 0.98 in 90ms while pressed; trigger scale 0.985 in 90ms, springs back over 150ms
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only, 150ms or less, no spring, no hold, check pre-drawn
motion.choose: from the open panel: trigger value swaps at once; panel holds 300ms so the check draws on the chosen row, then closes (140ms exit); input ignored during the hold; reduced motion closes at once. Closed-trigger typeahead commits with no hold

responsive.all: fluid to 320px; panel matches trigger width; filter input stays 16px so iOS does not zoom
responsive.touch: 44px trigger and 44px md rows, no hover-only action

accessibility: trigger role combobox with aria-haspopup listbox, aria-expanded, aria-controls only while open and while rows exist, aria-activedescendant while open; with searchable the trigger is role button and the filter field is the combobox
options role option with aria-selected; groups role group labelled by a presentation-role heading
keyboard: arrows (no wrap), Home, End, PageUp and PageDown (five rows), Enter and Space choose, Escape closes and restores focus, Tab closes
typeahead buffer of 600ms; a single letter cycles through matches
closed trigger: printable keys choose the first match directly
focus-visible ring 2px ink at 60% offset 2px; no focus steal on first render
empty results are a polite status line outside the listbox; an empty listbox is not rendered

content.options: Ten fictional cities in Europe, Americas and Asia-Pacific, each with a time-zone hint
content.label: City
content.demo: opens with Berlin, hovers London and Madrid, clicks the trigger to close, reopens with Enter, types lis so the highlight glides to Lisbon, presses Enter so the check draws on Lisbon while the panel holds, then reopens to show it checked

avoid: oversized rounded panels or radius above 12px
glass, blur-backed panels or gradient borders
an icon on every option or coloured group tiles
accent on the highlight, the trigger or the focus ring
portals or positioning outside the component
moving focus into the list on first render
a highlight that jumps instead of gliding
a check that only draws when the panel reopens
a closed field as the final frame of the demo
a check that only draws on reopen (it must draw on the choice itself)
a typeahead that swallows the second search on the closed trigger
